schedule.evaluation_role: previously inspected retrospective development month; never selection outcomes
schedule.transfer_caveat: Validation scores come from older monthly refits; one shared threshold transfers to the evaluation refit without a future recall guarantee.

frozen_selection_context.selection_rule: maximize worst historical month recall, then pooled historical TP, pooled AP, fixed candidate order

suitability.note: Development observations and experimental design have seen these periods; none is a new independent test.

policies.budget: Complete closed approval-day batches, floor(0.1*N), no carryover; score descending then order_id ascending. Unknown outcomes still compete.
policies.historical_labels: Actual delivery timestamp strictly before 2017-12-01; unknown outcomes receive no FN/FP/TP/TN or label-derived segment statistics.
policies.evaluation_labels: December outcomes only describe repeatedly inspected development evaluation; none are known at December selection or used to reselect.
policies.ranking: All rank intervals use the complete daily cohort before the outcome-availability mask.
policies.groups: Fixed route/state/promise/support/margin bins; minimum_sample_met requires 30 known rows and 5 known delayed rows. Groups overlap across separate dimensions.
policies.interpretation: Descriptive associations and model error overlap; no causal claim, new ensemble, or deployment improvement is established.
policies.coverage: Existing valid eventually-delivered eligible population only; not all approved, unfinished or cancelled orders.
policies.geolocation: Frozen geographic centroids have no event timestamps; prior static-geography assumption unchanged.
policies.holdout: No scoring on or after original fixed test start 2018-05-26.
